title: Implement SSRF protection with URL validation against internal networks
description: Add URL validation to block requests to internal network addresses, preventing Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) attacks
approach: Create a custom class-validator decorator that validates URLs against private IP ranges (10.x, 172.16-31.x, 192.168.x, 127.x, 169.254.x) and cloud metadata endpoints. Apply this decorator to all URL fields in crawl DTOs. Additionally, add runtime validation in the Crawl4aiClient before making requests.
